title: Regular Basic Course: Police Academy Module II
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Regular Basic Course: Police Academy Module II - Certificate of Achievement (8-15 units)
outcomes: Classify and describe basic criminal law, procedures and radio code communication for law enforcement in the State of California as defined by the California Commission on Peace Officers Standards and Training (POST).
Demonstrate professionalism, diversity and ethics for law enforcement in the State of California as defined by the California Commission on Peace Officers Standards and Training (POST).

Demonstrate proficiency in firearms, defensive tactics, and use of force procedures for law enforcement in the State of California as defined by the California Commission on Peace Officers Standards and Training (POST).
Conduct preliminary investigations and respond to crimes in progress calls through practical exercises as defined by the California Commission on Peace Officers Standards and Training (POST).
careers: sworn Level II Reserve Peace Officer

notes: The heading's '(8-15 units)' is the award-type range for this certificate class, not the program total; total_units is taken from the printed 'Units: 11.0' / 'Total : 11.0'.
Admission is by special application; the text notes Police Academy units may be applied toward the Administration of Justice Associate's Degree.
